Official stories about 9/11, the Kennedy assassination, and Gaza come under attack in this Tucker Carlson episode. Carlson argues that lies about these events serve the same goal: pushing America toward wider war, even nuclear war. The survey is dark by design, linking decades of deception.

Carlson moves case by case through the claims he says do not hold up. He asks who gains when the public accepts a false story and stops asking questions. The episode ends on his warning about escalation with Iran and Russia. Questioning viewers get the host's full charge against the war machine.

Tucker Carlson reports on how Christians are treated in the Holy Land by an Israel backed by US funds. The episode title calls the truth of it shocking. Carlson builds the report from tales on the ground.

Carlson shares cases of blocked worship, seized land, and fear among old Christian towns. He argues US cash props up the state that lets it stand. He asks why US churches stay so quiet. Listeners get a report that cuts against the grain of most US press. The library keeps the episode as a record of his stated case.
